checkerOwnCases: Frozen validated input with nested provenance object detachment
Encoded slash and literal percent-2F identities coexist and remain distinct after one decode
Changing read counter proves response sequence and preview use one state read
Malformed percent and overlong UTF8 reject without read
Near route and extra path reject without read
OPTIONS/POST/PATCH/HEAD reject with Allow GET without read
Unauthenticated invalid paths reject before decode and store access

maintainability.responsibility: createWorksitePreview owns only the supply projection; store.preview delegates and protocol owns authentication/path/method/sequence envelope
maintainability.inputPrecondition: Already validated KontStore state; not a second schema validator
maintainability.controlFlow: One business-named function, explicit material loop and ordinary route match/decode/read/send; no generic router, DSL, registry, parallel state or command bus
maintainability.compatibility: Legacy shape, NOT_FOUND/404, getBlocks fallback and supply order retained; absent nonexcluded referenced material explicitly fails INVALID_STORE instead of silently disappearing
maintainability.futureClientSeam: Human worksite and Agent can consume the same GET preview; projection itself remains transport-independent
maintainability.tradeoff: Existing linear asset lookup and exclusion membership are retained, avoiding additional indexes or duplicated state for this narrow query

acceptedScope: Pure detached existing worksite supply preview shared by KontStore and one authenticated GET route
Single encoded worksite identity with precise route/error/method rules and same-read seq
limitations: No new Desktop directory candidate generated or validated. Historical prepare-desktop-candidate inventory remains fixed at 25 and does not include worksite-preview.mjs
Normal package files including src does not establish that the reviewed desktop packaging path can deploy this change
Next packaging task must version the inventory while preserving old 25-file candidate verification; historical frozen artifacts were not rewritten
No production data access, desktop install/lifecycle, system setting, model, credentials/Session, commit/push/merge or human UI acceptance
